# UrCalc

> Free loan calculators for US borrowers — mortgage, auto, personal loan, and home affordability, computed to the exact cent, with full amortization schedules. No ads on calculators, no registration, no rounding.

## Tools
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://urcalc.com/mortgage-calculator): Monthly payment including principal, interest, property tax, home insurance, PMI (auto-drops at 80% loan-to-value), and HOA, plus exact interest savings from extra payments.
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://urcalc.com/auto-loan-calculator): Car payment including trade-in value, negative equity rollover, state sales-tax rules, and dealer fees.
- [Personal Loan Calculator](https://urcalc.com/personal-loan-calculator): Loan payment including origination fee and effective APR (true cost of borrowing including fees).
- [Affordability Calculator](https://urcalc.com/affordability-calculator): Maximum home price using the standard 28/36 front-end/back-end debt-to-income rule, with full monthly cost breakdown.

## Optional
- [$350,000 Mortgage Payment](https://urcalc.com/mortgage/350000-mortgage-payment): Example of the payment-by-rate-and-term tables available for loan amounts from $100,000 to $1,000,000 at /mortgage/{amount}-mortgage-payment.

All calculations run client-side in the browser; no financial data is transmitted to any server. Formulas are shown inline on each calculator page.
